title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Mon 26 Oct
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 11:15 to about 16:45. The evening before, the page called it normal, a hit. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway between Pukalani and Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 16 stations (GW2260 Kula, Hamakuapoko Rd, Kaonoulu 1 and 13 more); Nakula stopped at 11:00; the Mesonet could not be reached on 17 of 55 updates.
